description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git commit notes organization in subtrees, including functions for creating commits, verifying notes, and testing different fanout directory structures.

methods.name: start_note_commit
methods.description: Initializes a commit with notes in the Git repository.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that the notes for commits match expected output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and command.

methods.name: test_sha1_based
methods.description: Creates notes based on SHA1 hashes with specified sed pattern.

methods.name: test_same_notes
methods.description: Tests that two different note paths contain the same note content.

methods.name: test_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Creates notes with concatenated content for testing.

methods.name: verify_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Verifies that concatenated notes are correctly stored and retrieved.
